sources.entry: XWiki - Second generation wiki that allows the user to extend its functionalities with a powerful extension-based architecture. (Demo, Source Code) LGPL-2.1 Java/Docker/deb

summary.one_liner: XWiki Platform is a generic, extension-based wiki platform that provides runtime services for applications built on top of it.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and mostly navigational, so it describes the project at a high level only. It states that XWiki Platform is a generic wiki platform offering runtime services for applications built on it. It notes that XWiki Commons, XWiki Rendering, and XWiki Platform are released together under a shared version. It links to API docs, a Development Zone, and Developer, Administrator, and User guides. It also points to download/installation instructions, release notes, a CI build setup, an issue tracker, and forum and chat channels for community contact. The README itself contains no feature list or install commands.
use_cases: run a team or company wiki
build applications on a wiki platform
extend a wiki with add-on modules
how_to_run: Read the Download and Installation instructions on the XWiki.org site (linked from the README)
notable: Generic wiki platform offering runtime services for applications built on top
XWiki Commons, Rendering, and Platform released together with a shared version
caveats: README is brief and defers setup and feature details to external documentation
Issue tracker is external to GitHub, so GitHub Issues is not used
